profile.headline: GenAI Designer | Building Next-Gen Product Experiences with GenAI & Vibe Coding | UI/UX × Generative AI
profile.about: 💻 Computers fascinated me before I even knew what design was. I tried everything - web dev, frontend code, backend (hated it). But when I discovered UI/UX, something clicked. It sat right at the intersection of how things look and how people actually feel using them. Then GenAI happened. And everything changed again. ✨ Now I can take a rough concept, design the full experience, and build a working prototype using AI tools! All without ever getting stuck in backend. That combo? Most designers can't do it. Most developers don't think like designers. 🎯 I sit right in the middle. And that's exactly what's needed to build fast in the age of AI. 🛠️ I don't just design screens. I use AI tools to: → 🚀 Generate and iterate concepts 10x faster → ⚡ Build interactive prototypes without waiting on developers → 🏗️ Go from idea to working product, its design and logic without even touching backend code. Vibe coding changed something for me. The part I always hated, the backend, the 'just make it work' part. AI now handles that! So I get to stay exactly where I'm best: making the experience feel right. 🎨 Always excited to connect with fellow builders, designers, and AI enthusiasts! 📩
profile.hero_statement: Designing experiences that speak for your vision
profile.sub_headline: I create high converting UI/UX + AI-powered websites and prototypes for founders building a better world
